# Industrial Contractor Insurance

> Industrial Contractor Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for industrial contractors in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability for industrial sites, workers' compensation (high-hazard classifications), industrial general liability (industrial GL), commercial auto, contractors pollution liability (CPL), commercial umbrella, tools & equipment, and contractor bonds & surety. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability Insurance](/services/general-liability): Third-party bodily injury, property damage, and completed-operations liability for industrial contractors — including endorsements for plant owners and facility operators.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): High-hazard workers' comp for industrial labor — crane operators, ironworkers, riggers, pipefitters, millwrights, plant maintenance mechanics, and turnaround crews.
- [Industrial General Liability](/services/industrial-gl): Specialty GL underwritten for industrial facility environments — hot work, LOTO, confined space, and chemical/petroleum facility site-specific coverage.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](/services/commercial-auto): Heavy-duty trucks, service vehicles, crane transport rigs, and equipment haulers — plus hired and non-owned auto.
- [Contractors Pollution Liability (CPL)](/services/contractors-pollution): Environmental liability for industrial contractors working in or around hazardous materials — refinery, chemical plant, and pipeline pollution exposure.
- [Commercial Umbrella Insurance](/services/umbrella): Excess liability reaching the $5M–$25M limits industrial plant owners and energy companies require on contractor certificates.
- [Tools & Equipment Insurance](/services/tools-equipment): Coverage for specialized tools, portable equipment, scaffolding, rigging gear, and industrial instruments against theft, damage, and breakdown.
- [Contractor Bonds & Surety](/services/bonds): Performance bonds, payment bonds, license bonds, and maintenance bonds for industrial contractors required by plant owners and government agencies.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **industrial contractors** — firms working in refineries, chemical plants, manufacturing facilities, pipeline projects, and other heavy industrial environments.
- Coverage specialty: CPL (contractors pollution liability), high-hazard workers' comp, industrial GL, and high-limit umbrella for facility-owner certificate requirements.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible), including specialty and E&S industrial markets.
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
